description.value: The study investigated associations between problematic Internet-pornography use, craving, inhibitory control, and regional neural activity during a modified stop-signal task with neutral and pornographic images during fMRI.

spans.text: The study comprised a stop-signal task (SST) including neutral and pornographic images during fMRI and questionnaires to investigate associations between symptoms of problematic IP use, craving, and neural activity of the impulsive, reflective, and interoceptive system.

value: We hypothesize that reduced inhibitory control is associated with a hyperactive impulsive system as well as altered activity within the reflective system and interoceptive system.
we hypothesize that the aforementioned effects are higher when pornographic cues are present and for individuals with higher symptom severity of problematic IP use.

spans.text: We hypothesize that reduced inhibitory control is associated with a hyperactive impulsive system as well as altered activity within the reflective system and interoceptive system.

description.value: The study was conducted in heterosexual males with varying symptom severity of problematic Internet-pornography use. Participants completed questionnaires, stop-signal task training, and an fMRI study; the study was approved by the local ethics committee and participants provided informed consent.

spans.text: We examined 28 heterosexual males with varying symptom severity of problematic IP use.

name.value: left IFG pars opercularis and symptom severity of problematic IP use

definition.value: Neural activity during pornographic image processing was correlated with symptom severity of problematic IP use.

spans.text: Furthermore, a region of interest (ROI) approach was used to examine estimated values for the ventral striatum, IFG, and insula activity and to perform Pearson correlations on these data and behavioral as well as questionnaire data.

value: During pornographic image processing, activity in the left IFG pars opercularis was moderately and negatively associated with symptom severity of problematic IP use.
Symptom severity of problematic IP use was associated with decreased activity of the reflective system (IFG pars opercularis) during pornographic image processing.

spans.text: All activation loci reported in this work as MNI coordinates were verified using the Anatomy software (Version 2.1;  Eickhoff et al., 2007 ).

name.value: right insula and symptom severity of problematic IP use during pornographic image processing

definition.value: Right insula activity during pornographic image processing was negatively associated with symptom severity of problematic IP use.

spans.text: Furthermore, a region of interest (ROI) approach was used to examine estimated values for the ventral striatum, IFG, and insula activity and to perform Pearson correlations on these data and behavioral as well as questionnaire data.

value: Right insula activity correlated negatively with the craving/social problems subscale of the s-IATporn during pornographic image processing.
Symptom severity of problematic IP use was associated with decreased activity of the interoceptive system (insula) during pornographic image processing.

spans.text: All activation loci reported in this work as MNI coordinates were verified using the Anatomy software (Version 2.1;  Eickhoff et al., 2007 ).

name.value: left ventral striatum activity and delta craving during pornographic image processing

definition.value: Ventral striatum activity during pornographic image processing was negatively associated with delta craving.

spans.text: Furthermore, a region of interest (ROI) approach was used to examine estimated values for the ventral striatum, IFG, and insula activity and to perform Pearson correlations on these data and behavioral as well as questionnaire data.

value: Delta craving (pornographic minus neutral) correlated negatively with activity of the ventral striatum during pornographic image processing.
An increase in craving (delta craving) was associated with lower activity of the impulsive system (ventral striatum) during pornographic image processing.

name.value: right insula activity and SSRT during pornographic image processing

definition.value: Right insula activity during pornographic image processing was positively associated with SSRT.

spans.text: Furthermore, a region of interest (ROI) approach was used to examine estimated values for the ventral striatum, IFG, and insula activity and to perform Pearson correlations on these data and behavioral as well as questionnaire data.

value: Right insula activity correlated positively with SSRT during pornographic image processing.
Higher right insula activity was associated with better inhibitory control performance in the pornographic condition.

spans.text: All activation loci reported in this work as MNI coordinates were verified using the Anatomy software (Version 2.1;  Eickhoff et al., 2007 ).

name.value: right insula activity during inhibitory control processing and SSRT

definition.value: Right insula activity during inhibitory control processing was negatively associated with SSRT.

spans.text: Furthermore, a region of interest (ROI) approach was used to examine estimated values for the ventral striatum, IFG, and insula activity and to perform Pearson correlations on these data and behavioral as well as questionnaire data.

value: There was only one moderate significant negative correlation between right insula and SSRT in the pornographic condition, indicating that better inhibitory control is associated with higher right insula activity.
Better inhibitory control performance was associated with increased activity of the interoceptive system (insula) during inhibitory control processing.

Participants have to respond as fast as possible following the go-signal.

The SST version used in this study measures inhibitory control using three different variables: the certain go-RT as a measure for general response speed in certain situations, the uncertain go-RT as a measure for impulsive action tendencies on go-signals in uncertain situations, which also includes preparatory processes for a possible stop-process, and the stop-signal reaction time (SSRT) as a measure for inhibitory response ability.
